name: chirak-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Chirak Sales, Inventory, and Order Management platform.
long_description: Connect AI assistants and autonomous agents to Chirak. Query real-time inventory levels, record sales transactions, manage products and customers, and access revenue analytics via standard Model Context Protocol over STDIO.

api_key.title: Chirak API Key
api_key.description: Your Chirak API Key starting with chk_live_ (generated from Chirak App -> More -> Integrations & AI)

api_base_url.title: API Base URL
api_base_url.description: Chirak Cloud API Endpoint (defaults to production)

tools.name: get_chirak_help
tools.description: Returns a complete operational guide to Chirak store capabilities, operational cheat-sheet, active store context, and example AI prompt patterns.

tools.name: help
tools.description: Quick operational guide and cheat-sheet for Chirak store capabilities, active metrics, and recommended prompts.

tools.name: get_inventory
tools.description: Fetch current inventory products from Chirak, with options to filter by category or find critical low stock items.

tools.name: search_product
tools.description: Search for products in Chirak by name, SKU code, or barcode.

tools.name: add_product
tools.description: Add a new product to Chirak inventory with pricing, SKU, barcode, initial stock, and category.

tools.name: update_product
tools.description: Update details of an existing product in Chirak, such as selling price, cost, physical stock quantity, name, category, SKU, or barcode.

tools.name: adjust_stock
tools.description: Adjust physical stock quantity for a product (+/- change) with an audit reason (e.g. 'purchase', 'damage', 'adjustment', 'return').

tools.name: delete_product
tools.description: Permanently delete or remove a product from the Chirak inventory catalog.

tools.name: record_sale
tools.description: Record a sale order and automatically deduct the corresponding product stocks in Chirak.

tools.name: cancel_sale
tools.description: Cancel a sale order and automatically restore the ordered item quantities back into physical store inventory.

tools.name: get_sales_report
tools.description: Retrieve a summary report of revenue, total sales orders, units sold, and low-stock alerts.

tools.name: list_customers
tools.description: Retrieve customer contact directory and their lifetime spending metrics from Chirak.

tools.name: add_customer
tools.description: Add a new customer to the Chirak store contacts directory.

tools.name: update_customer
tools.description: Update contact details, delivery address, or notes of an existing customer in Chirak.

tools.name: delete_customer
tools.description: Delete a customer from the Chirak store directory.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Retrieve invoices, receipts, return invoices, and quote documents with optional filtering by type or status.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Fetch full details of an invoice or receipt including itemized rows, customer name, tax/VAT breakdown, and total amounts.

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Create and issue a formal invoice, sales receipt, or quote in Chirak with itemized products, customer details, tax rates, and currency.

tools.name: delete_document
tools.description: Permanently delete an invoice or receipt document from Chirak store.

tools.name: export_document_text
tools.description: Render a clean, formatted ASCII text/thermal receipt layout of an invoice or receipt ready for display, printing, or sending as text.

prompts.name: daily_store_briefing
prompts.description: Retrieve today revenue, total orders, and critical low stock warnings from Chirak store.
prompts.text: Provide a concise daily store briefing for Chirak. Query today sales report and check if any products are at or below minimum stock threshold.
